folderSettings.collectionDescription: Headers, auth, variables and scripts of the current request's collection
folderSettings.allCollectionsDescription: Headers, auth, variables and scripts that apply to every collection
folderSettings.headersNote: Sent with every request below. A request or inner folder overrides a header of the same name; switch a row off to stop an outer header from being sent.
folderSettings.authNote: Requests set to Inherit use this. Inner folders override outer ones.
folderSettings.varsNote: Folder variables apply to the requests below and override environment variables of the same name. A request's own variables win.
folderSettings.varsInvalid: Variables must be a JSON object.
folderSettings.scriptNote: Outer scripts run first and the request's own last before sending; after the response the order is reversed. Scripts run only in trusted folders.
folderSettings.timeLimitNote: Every script is stopped after this many seconds. The default is 10 and the most is 120.
folderSettings.testsNote: These checks run after every response below, in addition to the request's own.
folderSettings.docsNote: Markdown shown in generated documentation. HTML is never rendered.
folderSettings.docsPlaceholder: Describe what this folder is for.
folderSettings.folderNoAuth: Requests that inherit from this folder are sent without authentication.
folderSettings.inheritsNothing: Nothing to inherit: no folder or collection sets auth.
folderSettings.restrictedNote: This folder is not trusted, so its scripts, OAuth 2.0 settings, local MCP commands and file reads are switched off.
